title: Animal Groups Worksheets | 2nd Science Printable Practice Pack with Answer Key

PERFECT FOR

WHY TEACHERS LOVE IT

  • Clear directions young learners can follow

  • Each page matches a game on Creative Sprout Learning (Which Animal Group?, Mammal, Bird or Insect?, Animal Group Riddles), so children can play, then print and practice
